top_signals.title: Thailand Bond Outflows Hit Six-Month High on Oil, US Yields in September
top_signals.summary: Thai bonds suffered their biggest monthly foreign outflows since March as surging Treasury yields and the prospect of interest-rate hikes dimmed the appeal of the nation’s debt.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Sen. Hawley: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman declined to testify at rogue AI hearing
top_signals.summary: A Senate subcommittee on Wednesday is examining rogue AI, after a series of AI cyberattacks and increasing warnings about the risks of the technology.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Joy mixed with fear as U.S. forces depart Iraq leaving potential security vacuum
top_signals.summary: The withdrawal of troops ended the largest U.S. war of the century, which brought devastation and chaos from which Iraq has yet to fully emerge.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: RBA Downplays Risks From Bathla Collapse to Financial Stability
top_signals.summary: Australia’s central bank has downplayed concerns about the recent collapse of a large property developer, arguing that the company and its lenders in the private credit sector do not represent a system-wide financial stability risk.

top_signals.title: Trump unveils $200 billion South Korean investment in U.S. projects
top_signals.summary: Trump said the investment will include the construction of nuclear power plants, an LNG pipeline in Alaska and a power generation facility in Texas.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
